topic: family circumstances, marriage, children, paid work, household labor, and financial bargaining among U.S. adults
context: Imagine a nationally representative 2026 survey of U.S. adults. Predict the response distribution for the population named in the survey item. These questions were not observed in Pew American Trends Panel Wave 154 and are used only as explicitly model-synthetic candidate calibration moments.

relationship_status.question_stem: Which best describes your current relationship situation?
option_labels: In a relationship but not living together

children_at_home.question_stem: Which best describes whether children under age 18 live in your household?
option_labels: Children both under 6 and ages 6 to 17

household_income.question_stem: What was your total household income before taxes last year?

marriage_importance.question_stem: How important is being married to your own idea of a fulfilling life?

parenthood_importance.question_stem: How important is raising children to your own idea of a fulfilling life?

paid_work_priority.question_stem: How important is success in paid work or a career to your own idea of a fulfilling life?
paid_work_priority.item_text: Personal importance of paid-work or career success

childcare_division.question_stem: In a two-parent household with children, what is generally the best way to divide day-to-day childcare?
option_labels: One parent should do most of it
Both parents should divide it about equally
The parent with more available time should do more
It depends entirely on the family

housework_division.question_stem: In a household with two adults, what is generally the best way to divide cooking, cleaning, and other routine housework?
option_labels: One person should do most of it
Both adults should divide it about equally
The person with more available time should do more
It depends entirely on the household

financial_decision_style.question_stem: In a household with two adults, what is generally the best way to make major financial decisions?
financial_decision_style.item_text: Preferred style for major household financial decisions
option_labels: The higher earner should usually decide
The person who manages the money should usually decide

career_sacrifice_rule.question_stem: If a couple with children needs one adult to reduce paid work for family needs, what is generally the fairest approach?
career_sacrifice_rule.item_text: Preferred rule for deciding who reduces paid work
option_labels: The lower earner should reduce work
The adult with the more flexible job should reduce work
Both adults should reduce work as equally as possible
It depends entirely on the family
